title: Expired Food
description: Added an expiration mechanic to food.
body:
**Mechanics:**
1.Added a decay and expiration mechanic to all foods. By default, only apples have the spoilage and expiration feature.
**Countermeasures:**
1.Place ice inside storage containers to extend the shelf life of food.
2.Reduce the acquisition of food items.
3.If the Fabric Seasons mod is installed, food shelf life will change with the seasons: food lasts longer in winter and spoils faster in summer. You can store more food items during winter.
**Customization:**
1.You can customize food-related settings through the configuration file.
